GOV-F-003-S31.title: Stale Lock Detection and Recovery Mechanism
GOV-F-003-S31.description: Implement logic to detect expired locks (TTL breach) and allow safe takeover by a new owner. Include safeguards to prevent split-brain scenarios and ensure only one valid owner post-recovery.

GOV-F-003-S32.title: Lock Lifecycle Test Suite (TTL, Concurrency, Recovery)
GOV-F-003-S32.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, forced recovery, and concurrent access attempts. Validate atomicity and ownership guarantees under simulated race conditions.
